```{=html}
<style>
.insta-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 3px;
  margin-top: 1rem;
}

.insta-grid figure {
  margin: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
  position: relative;
}

.insta-grid figure img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
  transition: transform 0.25s ease, opacity 0.25s ease;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.insta-grid figure:hover img {
  transform: scale(1.06);
  opacity: 0.75;
}

.insta-grid .figure-caption {
  display: none;
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .insta-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
}
</style>
```

```{r}
#| results: asis

photos <- list.files("instagram", pattern = "(?i)\\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$",
                     perl = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

if (length(photos) > 0) {
  # sort newest first by file modification time
  photos <- photos[order(file.mtime(photos), decreasing = TRUE)]
  photos <- basename(photos)

  cat('::: {.insta-grid}\n\n')
  for (p in photos) {
    cat(sprintf('![](instagram/%s){group="insta"}\n\n', p))
  }
  cat(':::\n')
} else {
  cat('*No photos yet — drop images into the `instagram/` folder and re-render.*\n')
}
```
